craft_notes: Sthāyin: liṅga-pūjā unit 43. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: At worship-end, that-fluid-full-self having disposed, that downward-fa
ced and having fully worshipped, he should place, the wise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pūjānte tadrasāpūrṇamātmānaṃ pravidhāya tat adhomukhaṃ ca saṃpūjya sthāpayet vicakṣaṇaḥ
